title: Gideon's Three Hundred
reflectionQuestion: Gideon had only three hundred men, but God was with them, and that was enough. I wonder what feels too big for you right now, that God could help you with?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor -- second story in the new Judges category (gives it life). Phase 2 'Beloved': the smashing jars + blazing torches + trumpets are the highly-visual replay hook. WATCH-ITEM (Adam): soft on battle -- no fighting, no gore; the enemy is simply frightened/confused and 'ran away'. Frame = God makes a small, scared group brave; the victory is God's, not muscle's ('not because they were strong, but because God was with them'). Gideon himself is 'not brave at all' to start (relatable). Water-test simplified to 'God made the army smaller and smaller.' Soft close ('you'/'beside you'). VOICE_BRADFORD (strong, warm male; action/courage register).
